title: Self-Explaining Hate Speech Detection with Moral Rationales
reasoning: The paper's primary contribution is a framework called Supervised Moral Rationale Attention (SMRA), which is explicitly designed to incorporate moral reasoning into hate speech detection. It leverages Moral Foundations Theory to guide model attention and introduces a new benchmark dataset annotated with moral categories and rationales. The evaluation and methodology are centered on the concept of moral sentiment and its role in identifying hate speech, making it a core part of the research, not just a peripheral consideration.
